# Khronos sample models

Unmodified copies of models from [KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models), used by the Draco and meshopt tests to check that each compressed variant loads to the same geometry as its uncompressed one. Only the `.gltf` and `.bin` files are kept; textures are left out because the loader never reads images while loading. Each directory keeps the model's `LICENSE.md`.
